# ComposeUI

> ComposeUI is a small MVVM layer for building UIs in Python. You write the views once, as typed `attrs` classes, and a renderer binds each view to a widget of a backend: Qt (desktop, through `qtpy`), Textual (terminal), or the web (Starlette and htmx). Signals carry the events between the views, the model, and the app. Early-stage (pre-alpha): the API is small and still moving.

`composeui.core` holds the views, signals, and application, and imports no backend. A study file saves the views' state as JSON (`cattrs`). Python 3.9 and later; install from PyPI with `pip install "composeui[web,pyside6]"`.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/index.html): how the views, the optional model, signals, and renderers fit together
- [README](https://github.com/ehmoussi/composeui/blob/main/README.md): installation and a quickstart window

## User guide

- [User guide](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide.html): index of the pages below
- [Core concepts](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/core-concepts.html): views, signals, the model, studies, and the backends, and how ComposeUI maps to MVVM
- [Building views](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/building-views.html): define views, lay them out with optional frames, forms and their checks, the main view, its status bar and notifications, saving and loading state, unsaved changes, autosave
- [Reactive methods](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/reactive-methods.html): view methods that run again when a view field they read changes, with slow work in a task
- [Dashboards from a dataframe](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/dashboards.html): a dashboard's main view, a tutorial of a first dashboard, filters of a frame's columns, counts for a bar chart, a frame in a table, a user's CSV or Parquet file, and a frame's download
- [Widgets](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/widgets.html): labels, buttons, inputs, date ranges, choices of several values, uploads of one or several files, downloads, sliders, range sliders, progress bars, metrics, expanders, trees, Markdown, images, drawings, and the File menu
- [Organizing the window](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/organizing-the-window.html): pages, tabs, resizable panes, a list of views, menus, toolbars, a sidebar, and dialogs
- [Tables](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/tables.html): a table of records with sorting, filtering, and widgets in cells; a large table read from a list, SQLite, or a dataframe
- [Charts](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/charts.html): lines, dots, and bars in one chart, stacked bars, steps, categories, axes, their bounds, log scales and dates, a second y axis, reference lines, clicks, and report images
- [Maps](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/maps.html): geographic points on Qt Location and deck.gl maps, tile usage, viewport signals, and saved state
- [Running work in threads](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/threads.html): jobs, their progress and failures, external programs, reusable loading tasks, runs that follow the latest input, data loaded once and shared by the sessions, and a limit on the jobs that run at once
- [A SQLite model](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/sqlite-model.html): keep the app's data in SQLite with `DatabaseModel` and `SqliteDatabase`, each session's own (`per_session`) or one for every session (`shared`)
- [Importing CSV data](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/csv-import.html): a SQLite table of an `attrs` row class, filled from a CSV file or URL
- [Translating the app](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/translation.html): translation catalogs, and checking them
- [Running the app](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/running-the-app.html): start an app on a backend, open folders, files and pages for its user (`ClientCapabilities`), show a browser its own work (`browser_id`), reload it on a change, log messages, and serve it on the web with its limits (`WebSettings`) and its look (`WebStyle`)
- [Testing your app](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/testing.html): test the views, forms, jobs, downloads, and a model with pytest, without a backend
- [Using a coding agent](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/user-guide/coding-agents.html): install the ComposeUI skill for coding agents

## Examples

- [Examples guide](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/examples-guide.html): the example apps (pipe form, Markdown viewer, study inputs, task view, chart, catalogue, sweep, large table, first dashboard, Uber pickups, Uber pickups on a dataframe, data explorer, figure viewer, Batman, web hello, Textual demo) and how to run them

## Reference

- [Widget catalog](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/widgets.html): every view that a backend renders
- [API reference](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/api/index.html): built from the docstrings of `composeui.core` (view, signal, application, model, sqlitemodel, dataframesource, dashboard, study, translation, translationcheck, jobs, shared, reactivity, renderer, registry, reload, chartimage) and the backends

## Contributing

- [Technical guide](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/technical-guide.html): index of the pages below
- [Architecture](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/technical-guide/architecture.html): project layout, the registry, views and renderers, signals, reactive methods, shared data, and view state
- [Design of the web backend](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/technical-guide/web-backend.html): requests, page updates, scripts, sessions, and web tests
- [File transfers on the web](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/technical-guide/web-file-transfers.html): uploads, opening and saving studies, download tickets, and streaming
- [Reloading on a change](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/technical-guide/reloading.html): how `--reload` works on Qt, Textual, and the web
- [Extend ComposeUI](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/technical-guide/extending.html): how to add a widget or a backend
- [Development](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/technical-guide/development.html): setup, commands, tests, translations, code style, documentation, CI, and releases

## Optional

- [ComposeUI skill](https://ehmoussi.github.io/composeui/skills/composeui/SKILL.md): rules for a coding agent that writes a ComposeUI app (a `SKILL.md` file)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/ehmoussi/composeui): code, issues, and the roadmap (`ROADMAP.md`)
